findings.title: Shard-split queries apply ad hoc filters twice
findings.body: This interpolates each target with `request.filters` before shard discovery, but every generated shard request is then passed to `runSplitQuery`, which calls `applyTemplateVariables` again with the same `request.filters` (querySplitting.ts:299). `applyTemplateVariables` adds ad hoc filters to the LogQL selector, so shard-split requests end up with duplicated filter matchers (for example `{app="api", env="prod", __stream_shard__=~"...", env="prod"}`). This can produce invalid or unnecessarily different LogQL selectors and prevents equivalent requests from sharing query-cache entries. Interpolate/filter only once for the generated shard target, or distinguish initial template expansion needed for shard discovery from the final filter application.
